record.reason: EnvSimBench evaluates LLM-based environment simulation and proposes a constrained 4B simulator that cuts environment-synthesis cost by over 90% while improving yield; this is cost efficiency for a specialized agent-training simulator, not a general inference/serving optimization.
record.title: EnvSimBench: A Benchmark for Evaluating and Improving LLM-Based Environment Simulation
